{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print(f'Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {df[df["biomarker_baseline"] == -999].shape[0]}')

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print(f'Number of unique patient_id: {df["patient_id"].nunique()}')
print(f'Total rows: {df.shape[0]}')

# Check assay_batch distribution
print(f'Assay batch distribution:
{df["assay_batch"].value_counts()}')

# Check sample_seq distribution to identify re-tests
print(f'Max sample_seq per patient:
{df.groupby("patient_id")["sample_seq"].max().value_counts()}')"}
